title: feat(platform-objects): built-in sys_task and sys_note objects
body:
Fixes #36942

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：每个环境都会自带「任务」「备忘」两个对象，普通成员默认就能新建、查看、修改（不能删除），任何应用都能把它们放进菜单；菜单和字段文字已有十一种语言。
- 为什么做：起步应用专题的第一步，平台自带任务和备忘，权限各自独立，不挂到其它记录。
- 出错会怎样：成员只看得到自己建的任务、分配给自己的任务和自己写的备忘，别人的看不到；只新增两个对象和一条成员默认权限，可以整体撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/work/` (new): `sys_task` and `sys_note`, ordinary customizable objects (no `isSystem`, attachments on, comment feed left on).
  - `sys_task`: `title` (required), `description` (rich text), `status` (`todo` / `in_progress` / `done`, default `todo`), `due_at`, `assignee_id` (user, default `current_user`), `completed_at` (read-only), and a declared `owner_id`.
  - `sys_note`: optional `title`, rich-text `body`, a read-only `heading` (the title, or the body's first line when the title is empty) that is the object's `nameField`, and a declared `owner_id`.
  - Default list views: tasks `assigned_to_me` (assignee is me, status not done, by due time), `created_by_me`, `all` (kanban by status); notes `mine`, `all`.
- Sharing, the object's own only: `sharingModel: 'private'` over the declared `owner_id` (a `sys_*` object never gets the injected one; the security plugin stamps it with the creator), plus one declared sharing rule `sys_task_assignee` (the existing record-relative `field` recipient naming `assignee_id`, access `edit`). Nothing links to, grants or derives access from another record.
- `completed_at` and `heading` are kept by before-write hooks (`work/hooks.ts`). They assign the platform value over the writer's, because the engine's create-side read-only strip leaves a `sys_*` object to its own guards.
- `PlatformObjectsPlugin` registers both objects and the sharing rule on a manifest of their own (`com.objectstack.platform-objects.work`, project database) and installs the hooks in `start()`. A refused registration is logged at `warn`.
- `member_default` (`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`) grants `sys_task` and `sys_note` read, create and edit, no delete, in the `sys_comment` shape, per maintainer ruling 7131539862 (option A, verbatim 「1. #36942 任务/备忘默认权限： A。」). It opens the objects; no row policy is added. The rider (a per-object update alternative for `sys_task`) is **not** added: measured below, the `owner_only_writes` floor does not refuse the assignee's edit.
- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`: `sys_note` and `sys_task` join `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE['platform-objects']`.
- Labels: `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` imports both objects; the bundles are regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write` and the ten translated locales hand-written (zh-CN 任务 / 备忘, zh-Hant 任務 / 備忘, ja-JP タスク / メモ, ko 작업 / 메모, es-ES Tarea / Nota, fr Tâche / Note, de Aufgabe / Notiz, pt-BR Tarefa / Nota, ru Задача / Заметка, ar مهمة / ملاحظة), all 33 leaves per locale. Five leaves equal the English word and stay source-hashed as such: de and pt-BR `Status`, fr `Description`, `Note`, `Notes`.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts`: ADR-0131 D10 fate rows for `sys_task` and `sys_note`, beside `sys_unit`: fate `attribution`, census `PMAIN`, no anchors (members write them, the organization column is stamped from the writing context, and no parent row anchors a task or a note). Without them every `os migrate organization-ownership` / `os dev` ceremony refused with "sys_note carries organization_id but the ADR-0131 D10 inventory gives it no fate".
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.declared-rule-mirrors.integration.test.ts`: its `servedRules` helper lists the rules served on the fixture's object (`listRules({ object: 'crm_deal' }, …)`), because platform packages declare sharing rules of their own that every boot serves (`sys_task_assignee`). Every rule the fixture declares or inserts is on `crm_deal`, so both `toEqual` assertions still count each of them exactly; nothing is loosened. The edit put the file under `check:test-source-alias`'s source-reach half, so it now also pays its two dynamic workspace loads (`@objectstack/platform-objects/system`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`) at module top, as that gate prescribes.
- `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` regenerated by its generator: registered 108 → 110, in reach 57 → 59 (both `organization_id`), out of reach unchanged at 51.
- Changeset, all at patch: `@objectstack/platform-objects` (the objects), `@objectstack/spec` (the registry names), `@objectstack/plugin-security` (the `member_default` grant) and `@objectstack/cli` (the two inventory fate rows). `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `defineStack` now accepts a top-level action whose `objectName` is `sys_task` or `sys_note`, and the public surface grows; nothing narrows. `Metadata-protocol: none`, on the `sys_unit` roster-addition precedent: no metadata key, type or schema value is added, and a reference that already parsed now resolves.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/task-note-objects-36942.test.ts` (new, 6 cases, real runtime, one boot, the organization created after `bootstrap()`: `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` over in-memory better-sqlite3, `PlatformObjectsPlugin`, `SecurityPlugin` with the platform sets only, `SharingServicePlugin`; members hold `member_default` and nothing else, with the positions an ordinary member holds: `user`, `org_member`, `everyone`):
  - both objects register from `PlatformObjectsPlugin` with no application declaring either;
  - `member_default` carries exactly read, create and edit, no delete and no widening bit, on both;
  - status to done writes `completed_at` through the engine's write path, and leaving done clears it;
  - a task is read by its creator and its assignee, and not by a third member, by id and by list;
  - a note is read by its creator only, by id and by list (the assignee of another task included);
  - the assignee edits the task and marks it done (`landed`, `completed_at` written, `updated_by` the assignee); the third member's edit answers `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404 and the row is unchanged.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/work/work-objects.test.ts` (23 cases): declarations, sharing, views, the completion stamp and the note heading as units, plugin registration and its loud refusal.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.test.ts`: the item-6 pin, an app that declares neither object puts both in its navigation with `requiresObject` beside `objectName`; `defineStack` accepts it and `validateObjectReferences` reports nothing.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/bundle-ownership.test.ts`: the bundle owns both objects, and the duplicate-label walk covers them in every locale.

## Acceptance notes

**The ruling's premise holds with the grant in place.** A second member holding the same baseline reads neither another member's task nor note, by id or by list (the runtime test above). Ablation of the two `member_default` lines: 5 of the 6 cases go red (the creator's insert is refused without an object grant), and the file restores byte-identical to HEAD.

**Assignee edit under the ownership floor: allowed, measured with the floor in force.** The runtime test's members carry the positions the auth layer gives an ordinary member (`user`, `org_member`, the `everyone` anchor), and `owner_only_writes` is bound to `org_member`. A one-off probe on this composition (not committed) read the update-row filter `member_default` gives the assignee on `sys_task`: `null` with no positions, `{"created_by":"usr_tn_assignee"}` with the member's positions, so the floor applies. Under it, the assignee's `update` of a task another member created still goes through (`landed`, `completed_at` written), because the `sys_task_assignee` rule's `edit` share replaces the floor as the floor's deferral to the sharing verdict says. The third member's edit is refused with `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404 and the row is unchanged. So the rider's per-object alternative is not added.

**Navigation entries need `requiresObject`.** `defineStack` refuses `{ type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_task' }` in an app that does not declare `sys_task`, and accepts it with `requiresObject: 'sys_task'` beside it (seat decision Q3 = A: the contract stays). The starter app (#36944) spells the gate.

**Found on the way, filed as #36982 and fixed there (#37012, merged into this branch):** a declared sharing rule wrote no per-record grants in an organization created after boot until the next boot. The runtime test now runs on ONE boot with the organization inserted after `bootstrap()`, as a fresh environment's first sign-up does, and the `sys_task_assignee` grant is still written: the assignee reads and edits the task, and the second member still reads neither the task nor the note, by id or by list.

Also noted, not changed: `sys_*` objects get no recycle bin (ADR-0148), are not AI-readable unless they opt in with `aiReadable`, and are skipped by the user-deactivation "assigned work" census. The app-facing platform catalog for project authors (`skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`, built from a hand-kept subset) does not list either object yet; that is follow-up #37058.

## Verification

Read first:
1. `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`: the two `member_default` lines and their ruling comment, beside `sys_comment`.
2. `packages/platform-objects/src/work/hooks.ts` › `stampTaskCompletion`: the insert branch assigns over the client value; the update branch acts only when `status` is in the write.
3. `packages/platform-objects/src/work/sharing-rules.ts`: the assignee rule (`field` recipient, `edit`).

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/task-note-objects-36942.test.ts` → 6 passed.

Head `ab1bfc643c0` unless a line names another. That head merges origin/main (`719ef290776`).

- Floor probe (one-off file, not committed; same boot): the update-row filter `member_default` gives the assignee on `sys_task` is `null` with no positions and `{"created_by":"usr_tn_assignee"}` with the member's positions. Under that filter the assignee's update is `landed` and the third member's update is refused `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` / 404.
- Ablation of the two `member_default` lines (head `f55bc30d727`): 5 failed, 1 passed; the restored blob equals HEAD.

Neighbours (head `a34239ba506`): the platform-global column drop, the `os dev` ceremony and the sqlite-wasm integration files: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 15 passed. The inventory unit test: 26 passed.

The derivation warned that the tree is 2 commits behind origin/main, and that 2 derivation files changed across that range; this round makes one push only, so I did not merge again.
